items.title: Return signed usage agreement (Nutzungsvertrag)
items.quote: Den unterschriebenen Vertrag benötigen wir innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: The letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026 and the 14-Werktage period runs 'ab dem Briefdatum', so the letter date itself is the event and is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analog). Werktage per the letter = Monday to Saturday, Sundays and holidays excluded. Counting forward 14 such days from 19.11.2026: skipping Sundays 22.11 and 29.11 (no NW public holidays fall in this window), day 14 lands on Friday 04.12.2026. That day is itself a working day, so no further shift is needed (§ 193 BGB).
